children: China footwear and solar products maker's H1 revenue fell 14% yr/yr on lower OEM sales
Gross profit margin improved to 14.2% from a loss margin a year earlier
Net loss narrowed to RMB88 mln
Golden Solar expects to use its remaining RMB1.4 mln in 2022 placing proceeds by 31 Dec 2026
The Group has RMB70 mln standby funding and expects adequate funds to meet liabilities for at least 12 months
OEM PRICE COMPETITION - Co said intensified price competition from Southeast Asian manufacturers led customers to reduce orders, hurting OEM revenue
LOWER US TARIFFS - Co said lower US import tariffs reduced cost pressures and helped improve OEM gross margin
CAST-MONO ORDERS - Co said new customer orders for Cast-mono business drove photovoltaic segment revenue growth
